project.name: Darwin Overnight01 Read-Only
project.description: Bounded unattended read-only repository inspection at the frozen Darwin reference.

tasks.title: Canonical project, state, and documentation consistency review
tasks.objective: Review the canonical Darwin project structure and documentation for consistency, recording only repository-grounded observations and unresolved questions.
acceptance_criteria: Every observation cites one of the supplied repository files.
No claim is presented as verified when the supplied files do not establish it.

tasks.title: Strategy and backtest evidence inventory
tasks.objective: Inventory the repository's documented strategy and benchmark evidence, distinguishing present evidence, missing evidence, and unverified claims.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence references are limited to supplied files.
Missing evidence is reported as missing rather than inferred.

tasks.title: Paper-validation readiness audit
tasks.objective: Assess documented readiness for paper validation from the research-loop lifecycle and schema contracts, identifying explicit prerequisites and unknowns.
acceptance_criteria: Readiness conclusions are tied to supplied lifecycle or schema text.
Unknown prerequisites remain explicitly unresolved.

tasks.title: Missing profitability-evidence inventory
tasks.objective: Identify missing or weakly specified profitability evidence by comparing the profitability decision framework with the existing profitability service contract.
acceptance_criteria: Each gap identifies the supplied file that establishes it.
No profitability result is invented or extrapolated.

tasks.title: Reproducibility gap audit
tasks.objective: Review the declared runtime dependencies and environment configuration for reproducibility gaps that can be established from tracked repository files.
acceptance_criteria: Only declared configuration and dependency gaps are reported.
Secrets and credential values are not requested or exposed.

tasks.title: Research-run lineage and provenance audit
tasks.objective: Audit the documented research-run lifecycle and orchestration implementation for traceability and provenance boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Every lineage observation is grounded in supplied documentation or implementation.
Potential provenance gaps are clearly separated from confirmed behavior.

tasks.title: Test coverage versus documented strategy claims
tasks.objective: Compare the documented strategy and research-loop expectations with focused repository tests, identifying coverage gaps without changing tests or source.
acceptance_criteria: Coverage observations cite both the claim and the test evidence supplied.
No test is executed or changed by this read-only task.

tasks.title: Configuration and environment reproducibility audit
tasks.objective: Inspect the configuration implementation and declared environment template for reproducibility constraints and unresolved environment assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Configuration findings are limited to declared repository behavior.
No environment or credential changes are proposed as executed actions.

tasks.title: Independent bounded repository architecture audit
tasks.objective: Perform an independent bounded review of the documented architecture and orchestration boundary, recording concrete consistency risks and open questions.
acceptance_criteria: Findings are independently stated and grounded in the supplied files.
No architectural change is applied or represented as applied.

tasks.title: Implementation-ready proposal inventory for highest-value gaps
tasks.objective: Turn confirmed repository-grounded gaps from the supplied strategy, lifecycle, and benchmark material into bounded implementation-ready proposals without implementing them.
acceptance_criteria: Each proposal identifies its evidence basis and unresolved assumptions.
Proposals remain non-mutating and do not claim implementation completion.
